requirements.text: Given `Revisions used: 3 of 3` and ≥1 blocking finding, an interactive cap hit asks the user once (extend/accept/stop) and the choice is appended to the review log before anything else happens.
Choosing extend dispatches exactly one more revision.
The review-log header's `Revisions used: <M> of <cap>` denominator is raised in place, grepped `M of cap` shape unchanged.
Hitting the cap again re-asks the gate at most once per cap hit.
Choosing accept records residual findings' fingerprints under `## Accepted warnings`, sets `**Status:** Converged`, final block `CHARTER — Converged with warnings`.
Choosing stop ends `CHARTER — Blocked` listing residual findings, artifacts preserved — same shape as today's stop.
A recorded cap-gate choice is honored on a resumed run (after `/clear`) without re-asking.
A headless run at the cap with blocking findings still ends `CHARTER — Blocked` exactly as today — no gate, never a hang.
`plugins/wf/skills/charter/SKILL.md` ends no longer than its start-of-slice line count (280 lines).
Rationale for the new gate lives in `references/convergence-loop.md`'s reserved SUB-4 section, not inline in `SKILL.md`.

Only the user can extend the cap — never auto-extended, headless never softens this.
Touched files limited to `SKILL.md`, the paired `references/` doc, and the two version manifests.
Headless runs must never hang waiting on a gate.
Phase 5 remains the sole retry owner — no other phase gains cap-adjacent state.
Version bump is PATCH-tier and correctly applied to both manifests plus the marketplace top-level version.
"Verification evidence": replay against `_local/C031`'s final on-disk state (round 4, `Revisions used: 3 of 3`, 7 residual findings).
